_meta.description: Static CI mirror of failure audit validation rules. Do not edit manually — sync from D1 when rules change. See ci/sync-failure-rules.py for the sync command.

static_checks.description: Every references/*.md cited in SKILL.md must exist on disk

static_checks.implementation: Already in validate.py line count check

static_checks.description: No line may cite arxiv 2605.06445 or arxiv 2601.22025

Trigger description must not exclude valid request types via overly narrow example vocabulary. Check: description must not contain 'software = out of scope' or equivalent blanket exclusions for consumer-relevant domains.
SKILL.md body must not contain project-specific proper nouns (Loop, Glowmoon, etc.) except in the NOT-triggers or SEE ALSO sections. Project-specific content belongs in references/ files.
static_checks.implementation: grep_check: pattern='The Loop|Glowmoon|Farm-Grind', scope=body_only, exclude_sections=['NOT','SEE ALSO','Out of Scope']

static_checks.description: Any skill that packages or validates other skills must contain a self-application rule stating the process applies to itself. Check for: 'including.*itself' or 'self-application' in body.

behavioral_rules.description: Every change must be classified STRUCTURAL/TEMPORAL/BEHAVIORAL before implementation. BEHAVIORAL requires user confirmation.
behavioral_rules.enforcement: SESSION_LEVEL — cannot be enforced by static CI; enforced via skill-publisher Gate 0.5

behavioral_rules.description: For any recurring failure: BEHAVIORAL fix is insufficient — must escalate to STRUCTURAL or TEMPORAL.
Any audit/review of Claude systems must identify an external (non-Claude) judgment node. If none exists, scope to a bounded deliverable with a checkable exit code.
Establish platform constraints empirically before building. Do not discover constraints through failure.
Check total instruction length vs ~15-rule envelope. Any addition without removal increases compliance decay.
Any content user must copy/paste/act on: complete self-contained fenced code block, no truncation, handoff last.
behavioral_rules.enforcement: SESSION_LEVEL — enforced via user preferences A7
